title: Mixed Event — Play That Beautiful Sound! — Episode2 Customer Service Training

meta.Event Outline: Having surpassed RAD WEEKEND, life has been quiet for Toya. Just when he feels like trying something new, the owner of an instrument store who he owes a lot to asks him to deal with customers at an event!

rows.Line: Street SEKAI
Crase Cafe

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Shibuya Instrument Day?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: And you two are gonna go help out?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, due to a slight emergency.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: The manager of the shop who lends us the sound equipment we always use is gonna be there, but a few of his staff won't be able to make it, so he's shorthanded.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: That's where Toya and I agreed to help!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: You get to help sell stuff at a musical instrument convention?! That sounds like fun!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Yes, but it also sounds difficult.
Selling instruments means needing a certain amount of knowledge regarding them.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: You're right. That's why I'm going to have the manager teach me, while also learning what I can on my own.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hehe. I'm sure you'll get the hang of things really quickly, Aoyagi.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: If anything, An, you sure you're gonna be able to explain how to play them?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
I'm gonna brush up on what I can too, so I'll be fine!
I think...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: So, what does Shibuya Instrument Day involve exactly?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Umm... It's a convention where people can try playing different instruments and even buy them. There should be a website for it...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Oh, these pictures from last year should help! They're supposed to have a bunch of booths lined up like this!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Whoa!
Look at all the trumpets and guitars and stuff!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
This is incredible!
Each type of instrument comes in a variety of choices.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: They all sound and feel different based on who made them, and using what materials. Each one is very intricately designed.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
But so many choices...
Finding the right one seems really hard.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yeah, but imagine how amazing it must feel when you do.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
I see what you mean.
Finding the right instrument for you is like finding a trusty partner, yes?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
A trusty partner!
Hehe. It sounds like fun when you put it that way!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, if it means helping someone find the right partner, then it truly does feel worthwhile.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (That being said...)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: What's wrong?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Oh, it's nothing serious... But...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I'm a little worried about having to interact with customers.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I'll be moving instruments around and such that day, but the core of my job will involve actually selling them to customers.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: However, I have no customer service experience. I'm not sure if I'll be able to send anyone who comes to visit us home smiling...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Feeling nervous is completely understandable, since you've never done anything like this before.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Hmm... Yeah...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Oh, I know!
Why don't we practice interacting with customers?!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Practice?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yeah. My customer service skills are pretty good, so I should be able to teach you a lot about what to do and stuff!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: In return, you're gonna help me learn about those instruments! Then we'll call it even!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I don't know if I'd say even, but teaching each other what you can does seem like your best option.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yeah, to be fair, all I can teach him is how to interact with customers at a cafe. It's hard to say how helpful that's gonna be...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Still, with you as his teacher, he should be able to get in some good practice runs.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, you may be right...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I'll be taking up some of your time, Shiraishi, but if you don't mind teaching me...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
*Nod*
Okay!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I can play a customer for you, so let me know if you ever need me.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, thank you.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I know. Why don't you all practice here? It should provide the perfect setting.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Are you sure?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Thank you so much, MEIKO!
In that case, let's start practicing right away!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Okay!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Thank you for coming!
We hope to see you again soon!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
That's about everything...
What do you think? Got the hang of it?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I don't know if I'll be able to immediately put it into practice, but I've committed it to memory.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
That should be fine!
You can learn as you go along!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Alright, Len, Rin, you're up!

rows.Speaker: Len & Rin's Voices
rows.Line: Okay!

rows.Speaker: Len's Voice
rows.Line:
Whoa!
There's a really cool-looking cafe here, Rin!

rows.Speaker: Rin's Voice
rows.Line:
Yeah, wow!
Let's go check it out!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: They're just supposed to be playing the customers, but they seem really into it for some reason...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Hello!
We're your customers!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Oh, Toya, we have customers! Let's go!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, let's...!!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Maintain good posture like Shiraishi, and be light on your feet...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I-Is it just me or is he sort of walking like a robot? His joints seem really stiff...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I get that he's nervous, but this is a bit much.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (Speak as loudly and clearly as you can...!)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Welcome!!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Th...!
Thank you for having us...?!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Ha...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Hahaha!
Toya, you're scaring them!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
You gotta relax more!
Just act natural!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
O-Okay.
Let me try that again...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Th-That was scary!
You literally jumped at us all of a sudden!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
I'm sorry.
Trying to do this right is making me feel rather tense...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: You'll get the hang of things right away if you keep practicing. Just take your time and learn things at your own pace.
A few days later

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Thank you for coming.
We hope to see you again soon.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Nice!
That was great!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: You still seem a little tense, but you'd be perfect if you could relax a bit more!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Relax...
Yes, I agree.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Still, Toya, you've improved so much!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: He's right! Remember how clumsy and scary your greeting was at first?!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Really? That's good to hear.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Hehe. Nice work, everyone.
Why don't we take a quick break here?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Sounds good.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Oh, Toya, can you tell me more about instruments after we take our break? I understand the difference between yellow brass and gold brass now, but there's a ton of other stuff that I still don't really get.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, of course.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Also, I can try practicing with this a little more.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Oh, is that a mouthpiece for a trumpet?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, I've been learning how to use it on my own.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: My goal is to figure out how to produce a tone with it.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Wait, you're going that far?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Learning how to do that should make it easier for me to explain to novices how to actually play a wind instrument.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I won't be working in the demo area, so maybe it's unnecessary... But I'd like to take this opportunity to learn what I can.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: And we wouldn't expect anything less! You're always giving these things your best effort.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: I really admire how you see these kinds of commitments all the way through to the end!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
I hope this event goes well!
I'll be rooting for you, Toya!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes. Thank you.
Miyamasuzaka

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Let's see...
Ms. Mochizuki bought some bath cleaner for us already...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: So that should be everything we need.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
Okay.
Then, let's start heading back.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
*Nod*
Thank you for coming with me to buy these daily necessities, Mafuyu.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
It's okay.
I mean, I need them as well.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Right.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Clerk
rows.Line: We will now be holding a special drawing for any shoppers who made purchases at these establishments!

rows.Speaker: Clerk
rows.Line: We've prepared a wonderful lineup of prizes! You can win everything from gift certificates to event tickets, and even an all-expenses-paid trip!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Oh, they're having a drawing?

rows.Speaker: Clerk
rows.Line: Ah, young ladies, you can participate if you have your receipt! Would you like to give it a spin?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Huh? Oh, umm...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Shall we give it a try?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Yes. I suppose we should, since we're here.

rows.Speaker: Clerk
rows.Line: I'll just need to check the date on this receipt... Okay, you're all set! Feel free to spin the wheel!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Thank you.
Then...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: A ball popped out...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Oh, a red one. Is that good?

rows.Speaker: Clerk
rows.Line: *Gasp*

rows.Speaker: Clerk
rows.Line:
Congratulations!!
You win the Shibuya Prize!!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Huh? The Shibuya Prize?

rows.Speaker: Clerk
rows.Line:
Yes, it's sponsored by the city!
The winner receives a pair of tickets to Shibuya Instrument Day!

rows.Speaker: Clerk
rows.Line: It's a convention that's taking place this weekend at the hall by the station, where vendors will be selling a wide variety of instruments. Professional groups will also be performing a concert, and these tickets will allow you free entry!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: A concert...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (Come to think of it, I haven't had a chance to listen to anyone perform live recently.)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (It could also be a nice way for Mafuyu to take a quick break from things...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Since we're being given free entry, would you like to go?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I don't have any plans this weekend, so if you want to go, Kanade...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Okay.
In that case, let's go.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: *Nod*
